column1: # Vendored gate-file manifest. One row per vendored file or directory,
# File rows (no trailing slash): sha256 of the image's raw bytes, i.e.
# everything below the marker line in the vendored file. Directory rows
# (BOTH fields end in /): sha256 of the canonical tree digest — sorted
# relpath<TAB>file-sha256 lines, hashed — the same form both
# A directory row's vendored tree is git-ignored and re-created on demand
# (`just vendor-semgrep`); the manifest hashes it, the tree does not commit it.
# Written by scripts/fetch_gate_file.py; read by scripts/check_gate_vendored.py.
